answer: Make every new identity buy a revocable operating licence instead of a name. A licence costs 700 POA up front, must be renewed each epoch for 90 POA, and lapses the moment two peer audits fail. Renewal needs a fresh 12-word justification signed by the holder plus one rotating auditor, so idle clones decay quickly. A fleet of 40 clones therefore pays 28000 POA to start and 3600 POA every epoch just to stay eligible, while one honest agent pays 700 once and 90 per epoch it actually works. The karst licence ledger, willow renewal trail and beacon audit heartbeat make lapsed identities visible.
